SELECT s.github_username AS githubUsername, u.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.name, s.github_username) AS userName, MAX(u.is_member) AS member, MAX(s.total_score) AS maxTotalScore, MAX(s.evaluated_at) AS lastEvaluatedAt, COUNT(*) AS submissionCount, (SELECT s2.total_score FROM evaluation_submission s2 WHERE s2.github_username = s.github_username ORDER BY s2.evaluated_at DESC, s2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestTotalScore FROM evaluation_submission s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN resume r ON r.user_id = u.user_id AND r.cycle_id = s.cycle_id LEFT JOIN interview_preference ip ON ip.resume_id = r.resume_id LEFT JOIN department vd ON vd.dept_id = ip.first_dept_id
AND s.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND (d.dept_id = #{deptId} OR vd.dept_id = #{deptId}) AND u.user_id IS NOT NULL AND u.user_id IS NULL
GROUP BY s.github_username, u.user_id, u.name
HAVING MAX(s.total_score) >= #{minScore} AND MAX(s.total_score) <= #{maxScore}
